comparison.objective: Identify an intermittently broken ECG lead by flexing leads, then reject the faulty one.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled cable flexion, diagnostic observation, connector removal, and deformable-object placement.
comparison.success_condition: All leads tested, good connections preserved, and the faulty lead removed into the tray; candidate instead tunes and locks a rigid damper based on carriage impacts.
comparison.reason: Both use observation-guided iteration, but the tested physical abilities—cable fault provocation versus locked rotary damping adjustment—are meaningfully different.
